game: Ratchet & Clank Future: Quest for Booty
approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code to C with ps3recomp and of the SPU programs, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend; a launcher builds each game on your PC from your own copy
help: Testing on Windows itself (the project's own runs are under Proton on Linux)
Testing on AMD and Intel GPUs
Testing the Linux launcher on more distributions
notes: Early work, not playable. The game builds as its own Windows program on the shared runtime; a scripted new game from a fresh install reaches the ship deck, with about 90 seconds of scripted play without errors (one run). Needs your own copy of the game and the decrypted EBOOT made from it; the launcher builds the game on your PC. The project's own test runs use the Windows program under Proton on Linux (the Linux launcher starts it that way); players have reported results from Windows itself.
